scope: Additional shared-span alignment on the same 47 frozen accepted exports used for the audit-order experiment. No fresh fitting or application behavior change.
question: Does retaining the best source-pixel-error prefix improve independent rendered coverage, or sacrifice useful shared geometry to pixel quantization?
selection: Return the lowest original-source-error accepted prefix; ties retain later sharing. Continue exploring from the latest accepted state, preserving the original batch ceiling and all acceptance gates.
visualReview: Reviewed both 400-pixel floral-checker outputs; no clear visible improvement. Uneven cells and corner artifacts remain.
conclusion: All but one output are identical. These mixed quantized metrics do not justify replacing the current selection policy.
